body: I just got tempbanned for Encouraging Suicide. What does that mean, because as i know i haven't done anything...
body_tagged: I just got tempbanned for Encouraging Suicide. What does that mean, because as i know i haven't done anything...
title: Just a question!

replies.author: LFT
replies.body:
Hey ssaaaaam,

I was the one who bannned you, you were reported for telling a player to "KYS" (explained later) which is a form of encouraging suicide. Encouraging Suicide is when you tell a player to "kill themselves" which in your case you said "KYS" which is "kill yourself".

Evidence: http://imgur.com/vbSmf6V
